This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of hzVSF-v13 (normal saline solution) in hospitalized patients with COVID-19 pneumonia, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria outlined, including the need for a positive RT-PCR test for SARS-CoV-2 and certain medical conditions that would exclude participation.

Phase II trial for cpl-01 drug in mini-abdominoplasty surgery patients, with strict eligibility criteria including age, pregnancy status, birth control requirements, and exclusion criteria related to liver and renal function, blood glucose levels, and recent IP exposure.

This sample describes a phase II trial for patients with nonsquamous NSCLC harboring uncommon EGFR mutations, testing the combination of osimertinib with pemetrexed plus carboplatin or cisplatin, with specific eligibility criteria including age, disease stage, mutation status, prior treatments, and organ function reserve.

Phase II trial for previously treated individuals with metastatic colorectal cancer testing magrolimab in combination with bevacizumab, irinotecan, fluorouracil, and leucovorin, with specific eligibility criteria including ECOG performance status, adequate organ function, and exclusion criteria such as prior irinotecan therapy and specific mutations.

This phase II trial for lung cancer patients with unresectable stage III disease is investigating the efficacy of nivolumab, an immune checkpoint inhibitor, with specific eligibility criteria including PD-L1 expression, genetic alterations, and organ function requirements, while excluding patients with prior radiotherapy, autoimmune diseases, or certain allergic reactions.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of ramipril for COVID-19 patients who are hospitalized or in the emergency department, with specific eligibility criteria including age ≥ 18 years, confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection, and certain exclusion criteria such as hypersensitivity to ACE inhibitors and pregnancy.

This study in Phase 2 is investigating the use of dexamethasone injections in patients with COVID-19 and ARDS, with specific eligibility criteria related to confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection, moderate or severe ARDS, hyper-inflammatory ARDS sub-phenotype, and exclusion criteria including recent systemic corticosteroid therapy and active infections.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the drug pamrevlumab for COVID-19 patients with respiratory compromise requiring hospitalization, excluding pregnant or nursing females and those on mechanical ventilation, with no history of allergic reactions to monoclonal antibodies.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of colchicine, ruxolitinib, and secukinumab for COVID-19 patients with specific criteria including lung exposure on CT, SpO2 levels, and elevated C-reactive protein, while excluding pregnant patients, those with hypersensitivity to the drugs, liver failure, low glomerular filtration rate, and other specific conditions.

This study in phase II is investigating the use of clazakizumab in patients with confirmed COVID-19 and respiratory failure, with specific inclusion criteria related to age, disease confirmation, respiratory distress, and consent requirements, while excluding individuals with certain medical conditions and pregnancy.

This trial in phases PHASE1 and PHASE2 is investigating the use of nab-paclitaxel in patients with locally advanced unresectable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer who have failed prior anthracycline and taxane treatments, with specific eligibility and exclusion criteria, and the icd-10 code C847A.

This trial is investigating the efficacy of POL6326 (balixafortide) in combination with eribulin and nab paclitaxel for female patients with advanced breast cancer, requiring specific prior chemotherapy-based lines of treatment and meeting various eligibility criteria, while excluding patients with certain medical conditions or prior treatments.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the effectiveness of hydroxychloroquine in preventing SARS-CoV-2 infection among healthcare workers with specific exposure criteria, while excluding individuals with certain medical conditions, drug interactions, and allergies.

Phase II trial for locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer testing the drugs tenalisib 800mg and tenalisib 1200mg with eligibility criteria including age ≥18, ECOG performance status 0-2, and exclusion criteria such as HER-2 positive breast cancer and prior exposure to PI3K inhibitors.

This study in Phase 2 aims to investigate the effects of sodium nitrite on frail elderly individuals with sedentary lifestyles, with specific eligibility criteria including age ≥70 years, sedentary lifestyle, and exclusion criteria such as specific chronic conditions, drug dependencies, and unstable psychiatric diagnoses.

This study in phase II is investigating the use of colchicine and naltrexone in hospitalized COVID-19 patients with moderate disease, excluding those with severe/critical COVID-19, certain comorbidities, specific medication use, and other criteria as detailed in the eligibility and exclusion criteria.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of recombinant human plasma gelsolin (rhu-pgsn) in hospitalized patients with laboratory-confirmed or highly suspected COVID-19, with specific eligibility criteria including weight limit, severity score, symptoms, vital sign abnormalities, radiographic findings, and hyperinflammatory status, while excluding patients with negative RT-PCR test for COVID-19, ECMO, pregnancy, active cancer treatment, organ transplantation, chronic mechanical ventilation or dialysis, and end-stage diseases.

This study in Phase 2 is investigating the use of dexmedetomidine and general anesthetic in patients aged 12-69 with surgically diagnosed pheochromocytoma, excluding those with extremes of age, ASA III & IV, history of cardiac or cerebral events, major drug reactions, major muscle, endocrinal or hematologic disorders, pregnant or lactating women, and those with poor Echo-heart findings.

This trial in phases II and III is investigating the use of adalimumab injection for frozen shoulder in adults, with detailed inclusion and exclusion criteria including restrictions on prior treatments and medical conditions.

This study in phases 1 and 2 focuses on the effects of different doses of cannabis on occasional users aged 21-65, with specific inclusion and exclusion criteria including restrictions on other drug use, medical conditions, and psychiatric disorders.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of nicotinamide in patients with Friedreich Ataxia who meet specific eligibility criteria, including genetic diagnosis, age, weight, and absence of certain medical conditions, while excluding those with hypersensitivity to nicotinamide, HIV positive status, substance abuse history, and other specified conditions.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of topical tretinoin in treating Striae Distensae in individuals meeting specific eligibility criteria, excluding those with certain skin conditions, recent surgeries, or contraindications to tretinoin, among other factors.

This study in Phase 2 is investigating the efficacy of different doses of Susu Xiao'er Zhike granules in treating wind cold cough syndrome in children aged 6-14 with common cold, with specific eligibility criteria and exclusion criteria outlined.

This study in PHASE1 and PHASE2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of drug therapy according to Vietnamese MOHS procedure in patients diagnosed with COPD, with specific eligibility criteria including age between 40-75 years old, diagnosed with COPD stage B, C, or D according to GOLD 2019, and exclusion criteria such as smoking, asthma, cancer, and complex cardiovascular diseases.

Phase II trial for Eosinophilic Esophagitis testing famotidine and loratadine in patients over 18 with >15 eosinophils per hpf on esophageal biopsies, excluding those on certain medications or with contraindications to esophagogastroduodenoscopy.

This study in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of remdesivir in treating Ebola and HIV/AIDS in healthy men and women aged 18 to 55, with specific eligibility criteria including normal vital signs, negative HIV status, and the requirement for highly effective contraception methods for women of childbearing potential.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of the mRNA-1273 vaccine (Moderna) in renal transplant patients who have not developed immunity to SARS-CoV-2, with specific eligibility and exclusion criteria outlined.

This study in Phase 2 is investigating the use of ciclesonide metered dose inhaler (alvesco) for treating mild COVID-19 in patients meeting specific eligibility criteria, excluding those with hypoxia, pregnancy, immunocompromising conditions, and certain organ dysfunctions.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of granisetron hydrochloride in patients with sepsis who meet specific diagnostic criteria, including age range and procalcitonin levels, while excluding patients with certain medical conditions and characteristics, such as pregnancy, recent myocardial infarction, and various other criteria.

This trial in phases I and II is investigating the use of different doses of KPG-818 in patients diagnosed with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) who meet specific eligibility criteria, including age, BMI, SLE diagnosis criteria, and pregnancy precautions, while excluding patients with certain infections, malignancies, and other conditions.

This trial in Phase 2 aims to evaluate the efficacy of dapagliflozin 10mg in patients with end-stage heart failure meeting specific eligibility criteria, including NYHA class ≥3, LVEF ≤ 35%, and being on optimal medical management for at least 30 days, while excluding patients with certain conditions like uncontrolled infections and severe hepatic impairment.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the drug AZD8233 in participants with Hyperlipidaemia who meet specific eligibility criteria, including age range, lipid levels, and stable statin therapy, while excluding those with certain medical conditions or recent medication history.

This trial in Phase 2 is investigating the use of pegylated interferon lambda for treating confirmed COVID-19 patients, with specific eligibility criteria including recent positive SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR test, exclusion criteria such as recent use of certain medications, and various medical parameters for enrollment.
